trial_name.text: Study IOM-104A (coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography), a blinded re-read of studies 48,848-001A, -001B, -002A, and -002B

citations.quote: - Coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography: Study IOM-104A (48,848-001A, 48,848-001B, 48,848-002A, 48,848-002B)
- Coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography: Study IOM-104A (48,848-001A, 48,848-001B, 48,848-002A, 48,848-002B)

phase.text: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group clinical studies

citations.quote: Study Design: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group clinical studies.

design.text: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group studies; patients randomized to receive Iomervu 400 mg/mL (N=59) or iopamidol 370 mg/mL (N=58), or Iomervu 300 mg/mL (N=59) or ioversol 320 mg/mL (N=61)

citations.quote: Study Design: Blinded re-read of prospective, randomized, double-blind, parallel group clinical studies. In 48,848-001A and 48,848-001B, patients were randomized to receive Iomervu 400 mg/mL (N=59) or iopamidol 370 mg/mL (N=58). In Studies 48,848-002A and 48,848-002B, patients were randomized to receive either Iomervu 300 mg/mL (N=59) or ioversol 320 mg/mL (N=61).

population.text: Adult patients undergoing coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography

citations.quote: The full analysis population is generally representative of the U.S. population for which coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography would be indicated

endpoint.text: Non-inferiority of Iomervu to comparator in the proportion of patients with adequate quality of opacification and anatomic visualization, using a 10% non-inferiority margin

citations.quote: The primary objective of IOM-104A was to demonstrate non-inferiority of Iomervu to the comparator in the proportion of patients with adequate quality of opacification and anatomic visualization using a 10% non-inferiority margin.

n.text: 118 patients received Iomervu and 119 received iopamidol or ioversol in the full analysis population

citations.quote: A total of 118 patients received Iomervu and 119 patients received iopamidol or ioversol and were included in the full analysis population of the IOM-104A re-read study.

result.text: At least 98% of image sets in both the Iomervu and comparator groups were rated as having adequate quality visualization (score 3-5) by all readers, with the lower bound of the 95% CI at least 91%; the upper limits of the 95% CIs for the between-group difference were within the 10% non-inferiority margin for all readers

citations.quote: at least 98% (lower bound of 95% CI at least 91%) of image sets in the Iomervu and comparator groups were rated as having adequate quality visualization, defined as fair, good, or excellent (score of 3-5) on a 5-point scale, by all readers (Table 27).

The upper limits of the 2-sided 95% confidence intervals for the difference in the proportion of patients with adequate quality visualization were within the 10% non-inferiority margin for all readers

indication.text: IOMERVU is a radiographic contrast agent indicated for intra-arterial procedures (cerebral arteriography including IA-DSA in adults and pediatric patients; visceral and peripheral arteriography and aortography including IA-DSA in adults and pediatric patients; coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography in adults; radiographic evaluation of cardiac chambers and related arteries in pediatric patients) and intravenous procedures (CT of the head and body; CT angiography of intracranial, visceral, and lower extremity arteries; coronary CT angiography; and CT urography)

citations.quote: IOMERVU is a radiographic contrast agent indicated for:
- Cerebral arteriography, including intra-arterial digital subtraction angiography (IA-DSA), in adults and pediatric patients
- Visceral and peripheral arteriography and aortography, including IA-DSA, in adults and pediatric patients
- Coronary arteriography and cardiac ventriculography in adults
- Radiographic evaluation of cardiac chambers and related arteries in pediatric patients
- Computed tomography (CT) of the head and body in adults and pediatric patients
- CT angiography of intracranial, visceral, and lower extremity arteries in adults and pediatric patients
- Coronary CT angiography in adults and pediatric patients
- CT urography in adults and pediatric patients

target_moa.text: Iomeprol is an iodinated radiographic contrast agent that opacifies the vessels and body structures where the contrast agent is present following intravascular (intra-arterial or intravenous) administration, permitting radiographic visualization of internal structures through attenuation of X-ray photons

citations.quote: Iomervu (iomeprol) injection is an iodinated radiographic contrast agent that opacifies the vessels and body structures where the contrast agent is present following intravascular administration, permitting visualization of the internal structures through attenuation of x-ray photons.

Mechanism of Action	Iomeprol is a radiographic iodinated contrast agent that opacifies the vessels and body structures where the contrast agent is present following intravenous or intra-arterial administration, permitting radiographic visualization of the internal structures through attenuation of X-ray photons.

modality.text: Small molecule (iodinated radiographic contrast agent; iomeprol, molecular formula C17H22I3N3O8, molecular weight 777.09)

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥0.5%) among 4,621 adult patients were feeling hot (2%), headache (1.2%), nausea (1%), chest pain (0.6%), back pain (0.5%), and vomiting (0.5%). Serious risks include life-threatening or fatal hypersensitivity reactions including anaphylaxis, acute kidney injury, cardiovascular adverse reactions, and severe cutaneous adverse reactions.

citations.quote:
Table 5: Adverse Reactions Reported in \ge 0.5\% of 4,621 Adult Patients Receiving Intra-arterial or Intravenous Administration of IOMERVU in Clinical Trials
Adverse Reaction	Incidence (%)
Feeling hot	2
Headache	1.2
Nausea	1
Chest pain	0.6
Back pain	0.5
Vomiting	0.5

IOMERVU can cause life-threatening or fatal hypersensitivity reactions including anaphylaxis. Manifestations include respiratory arrest, laryngospasm, bronchospasm, angioedema, and shock [see *Adverse Reactions (6.2)*].

detail.text: WARNING: RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION — intrathecal administration, even if inadvertent, may cause death, convulsions, cerebral hemorrhage, coma, paralysis, arachnoiditis, acute renal failure, cardiac arrest, seizures, rhabdomyolysis, hyperthermia, and brain edema; IOMERVU is for intra-arterial or intravenous use only

citations.quote: ## WARNING: RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION

Intrathecal administration, even if inadvertent, may cause death, convulsions, cerebral hemorrhage, coma, paralysis, arachnoiditis, acute renal failure, cardiac arrest, seizures, rhabdomyolysis, hyperthermia, and brain edema. IOMERVU is for intra-arterial or intravenous use only [see *Dosage and Administration* (2.1) and *Warnings and Precautions* (5.1)].

requirement.text: Quality CMC study for environmental assessment: submit a final environmental assessment report (fish early life-stage assay such as OECD 210); NDA 216016 has PMC 4662-1, final report submission date 01/31/2025

citations.quote: Each NDA has one CMC post marketing commitment (PMC) for environmental assessment. NDA 216016 has PMC 4662-1 and NDA 216017 has PMC 4661-1. The PMCs are identical in content.

PMC Description	Submit a final environmental assessment report
Final Report Submission Date	01/31/2025

Therefore, the EA team recommended the applicant conduct a fish early life-stage assay such as OECD 210, so as to enable the Agency to meet the requirement to determine whether approval of this drug application would significantly affect the quality of the human environment in the US, per 21 CFR 25.15(a).
Priority or Standard	Standard

summary.text: IOMERVU was approved as a standard-review 505(b)(2) New Drug Application for iomeprol, a new molecular entity, with no accelerated approval, breakthrough, fast track, orphan, or priority-review designations; approval was based on adequate and well-controlled studies and literature with no advisory committee meeting held.

citations.quote: Application Type	505(b)(2) New Drug Application
Priority or Standard	Standard
Iomeprol has not been approved in the United States and is a new molecular entity (NME).
